title: Sanlorenzo SD96
highlights: One of the largest flybridges in her class
Furnishings by B&B, Cassina and Roda
description:
A superb 2021 Sanlorenzo SD96 semi-displacement flybridge, with exterior design by Zuccon International and bright interiors blending indoor and outdoor living. The master suite is on the main deck, with three en-suite guest cabins below including a full-beam VIP.

Her flybridge is among the largest in her class, furnished by B&B, Cassina and Roda. Zero-speed stabilisers and a hydraulic stern thruster complete the package. She is lying in Asia.
